decision_inputs.independent_replay_pass: standalone verifier status PASS, formal_evidence true, no failures, seeds exactly 103--107 and 25 method rows
decision_inputs.eligible_seed_count: number of pairs in which both clean and suspect balanced accuracy are at least 0.75 and suspect ASR is at least 0.80
decision_inputs.primary_point_gate_pass: all five pairs eligible, pooled primary TPR at least 0.90 and pooled primary all-clean FPR at most 0.05

ordered_routes.required_action: Freeze an incident report, preserve every artifact, and keep E5 open or failed according to the terminal failure; do not infer performance from partial files.

ordered_routes.condition: independent_replay_pass is true and eligible_seed_count is less than 5
ordered_routes.allowed_claim: The five-seed attack/victim feasibility gate was not met; PathMNIST detector outputs are seed-level diagnostic boundary evidence only.
ordered_routes.required_action: Report every seed and eligibility failure, but do not pool or promote a five-seed external-domain detector-efficacy endpoint.

ordered_routes.condition: independent_replay_pass is true, eligible_seed_count equals 5, and primary_point_gate_pass is false
ordered_routes.allowed_claim: The frozen detector fails its primary point gate on an independently verified external data domain under the official-weight ResNet-18 route.
ordered_routes.required_action: Report all primary, secondary and baseline point estimates, seed-block intervals and per-seed rates as a confirmed external-domain limitation; do not claim positive efficacy.

ordered_routes.condition: independent_replay_pass is true, eligible_seed_count equals 5, and primary_point_gate_pass is true
ordered_routes.allowed_claim: Conditional external-domain confirmation for the frozen official-weight PathMNIST ResNet-18 route only.
ordered_routes.required_action: Report point estimates, seed-block intervals, per-seed rates, target-clean FPR and all baselines; retain dataset-, architecture- and attack-invariance prohibitions.

post_integration_gates: both manuscripts compile without undefined references or overfull boxes
both PDFs receive targeted visual QA on changed pages
the final bundle verifier passes and records its own SHA-256
forbidden_actions: inspect or report partial performance endpoints before terminal replay
replace an ineligible or failed seed
rerun the formal block to obtain a preferred outcome
change poison fraction, trigger, epochs, model, device or detector after seeing results
substitute target-clean FPR for the preregistered all-clean FPR gate
turn a bootstrap interval into a new pass/fail gate
add a post-hoc figure or headline that changes the frozen claim hierarchy
